reference_rule: Median admitted standalone service ms across full reconciled Heavy pool; same physical reference for mean and P95, not a tail SLO or measured P95 reference. Independent of Module19 outcome and Proposed labels.
development_groups: Module14F: profiles (g/M measured here cannot independently validate same profiles)
Module19: ALL cases including all negative and failed results
retrospective_holdout_groups: Module16: entire full-pool six-task deployment combination and LOW/MID workloads, all repetitions together
holdout_limits: Retrospective archival holdout, already reported publicly within project; no fitting to these observations, no blind/prospective claim. Only one deployment per offered workload exists: independent matched deployment-ranking sample count is zero. Module17 own holdout supports only its original scope.

generator.method: MILP linear normalized-service + safe-memory seeds; target G fractions [free,0,.01,.05,.2,.5,1], rho caps [.8,.95]; retain frozen historical candidates; generation weights main plus low/high memory; no phase restrictions
generator.completeness: Heuristic candidate set; not an exhaustive utility optimum. Same deployment may host multiple Specialists; measured counts unmodified.

predictor.method: 120-second deterministic-periodic FIFO fluid-service replay with family round robin; path s0 * replicas/g(count). Constant service captures queue collisions; does not claim sample-tail model or transferable interference calibration.
predictor.stress_interpretation: Engineering scenarios, NOT fitted corrections, confidence intervals or measured bounds; no global Module17 transfer.
predictor.calibration: No parameter fit to Module19 or holdout. Frozen independent standalone s0/g/M only. Relative ranking hypothesis tested separately.
predictor.structural_limit: Constant service omits sample variability and cross-process interference; P95 and capacity carry high uncertainty.

three_phase_test: For each pool/budget/target evaluate every QPS. Natural LOW reuses G with no target S; MID deploys target S with G fraction zero; HIGH mixed. Require LOW beats feasible S-only, MID beats feasible G-only, HIGH beats best feasible pure route by >0.01; all nominal constraints pass. Strict increasing LOW<MID<HIGH; optional stress robustness separate.
